author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದೇಹದಾಲಸ್ಯವಿರೆ ಬದುಕೆಂದು ನಶ್ವರವು
ದಾಹವಿರೆ ಕಲಿಕೆಯಲಿ ವರ್ಣಮಯ ಬದುಕು
ಗೇಹದಲಿ ನೇಹವಿರೆ ಸಂಸಾರ ಸುಂದರವು
ಊಹೆಯಲೆ ಬದುಕದಿರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If the body is lazy, life is always perishable;
if there is thirst for learning, life is full of colour;
if there is affection in the home, family life is beautiful;
don’t live on guesswork, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Laziness wastes life; hunger for learning colours it; love makes a home beautiful. Live with clear purpose, not on assumptions.
